population_description: Synthetic ship-design records supplied as the complete nltl:ship population of each input. External legal/application eligibility and the experimental source-edition selection are research assumptions, not facts inferred from RDF. This is not real-vessel certification. The population includes incomplete, inconsistent and unrecognized-value records; represented correctness is not assumed. Conditions inside the represented requirement, effective activation, missing represented inputs, paths, units, datatypes and query correctness remain for generated SHACL to address from supplied source/schema. The represented domain is section 4.1.1 L records for synthetic designs externally assumed eligible for the selected 2021 regulation, including its construction-date/application scope. The proposed data-role interpretation is that ruleLength records L used by the design and classificationSocietyRuleLength records a separately supplied classification-society reference quantity. Both are existing direct ship-owned quantities in canonical metres/decimal encoding. Authenticity of the external society datum is assumed for research, not calculated or certified from a society-name string. No relationship between their values is assumed in this admission; the source obligation remains for generated SHACL.
